name: Yog-Sothoth de Tingyuan
source:
The main character inherits an ancient villa burdened with shadowy debts from their adopted father— an esteemed professor in meteorology... and the supernatural. 

To escape from the clutches of this mysterious debt, he tries to turn the villa into a profitable hotel and meets enigmatic guests including Death incarnate, a dragon devoted to alchemy, a spirit-hunting chef, and a bioroid maid.

Features a lengthy in-depth story and strategic choices for how to manage your hotel.

The fate of the world will be shaped by your decisions, and your staff may fall for you based on your choices. This game offers up to 21 different endings.

Information is based on the Steam store description.
